title: Disk usage above 90 percent
steps: 1) Confirm growth rate from metrics. 2) Check logrotate errors in the system log. 3) If rotation failed, open a severity-2 ticket for the platform team to fix directory permissions; do not delete logs manually. 4) If growth exceeds 1 GB per hour and disk is above 95 percent, page the on-call engineer.

title: High API latency
steps: 1) Compare p95 latency with the 300 ms objective. 2) Look for slow upstream dependencies in the log. 3) Check connection-pool saturation. 4) Open a severity-3 ticket naming the slow dependency.

title: Replication lag
steps: 1) Lag under 30 seconds is normal for the reporting replica. 2) Above 300 seconds, open a severity-2 ticket.
